environment: Owned ARM64 API 36 emulator and isolated Linux X11 desktop through QA relays

tests.name: complete-cache-and-local-scroll
tests.detail: With the owned provider log temporarily unavailable, the app reopened cached data and scrolled older records locally; all 10000 records and the 3MiB tool output remain in the independent cache.

tests.name: split-controls-and-release
tests.detail: Owned canvas receives both held-button movements, paired releases and continuous wheel input.

tests.name: split-layout-space
tests.detail: Closing the 176dp panel returns space to Chat and keeps the composer bottom fixed.

tests.name: fullscreen-reference-control
tests.detail: Mouse-shaped left/right/wheel control and right-hand rail replace the fullscreen trackpad; lower positioning grip and close button stay reachable at the edge.

tests.name: zoom-pan-coordinate-mapping
tests.detail: At 2x zoom after a 110x40 pan, the viewport center maps to source (905,520). One-finger panning sends no remote drag.

tests.name: large-tool-output-virtualized
tests.detail: The full 3MiB tool result stays in data/cache; its detail dialog lays out only bounded 1024-character chunks in a virtual list.

tests.name: new-output-preserves-reading-position
tests.detail: Appending source message QA10000 keeps the same earlier visible messages and pixel bounds; the collection is updated without automatic scrolling.

tests.name: return-to-latest-is-local
tests.detail: Return-to-latest scrolls the complete local collection to the appended message without replacing it.
